proposals.title: Lab-native Code Mode / orchestration runner
proposals.evidence: 16/36 traced Gen1 tool calls were shell; self-hosting still composes multi-step procedures manually.
proposals.expected_benefit: Collapse repeated inspect/edit/test/restart sequences into auditable guest-local programs while retaining broad primitives.

proposals.title: Structured patch/diff editing workflow
proposals.evidence: Current write primitive replaces whole files; self-modification still depends on source rewrites.
proposals.expected_benefit: Smaller safer edits, diff preview, rollback points, lower context use.

proposals.title: Guest-local browser automation
proposals.evidence: HTTPS/download works, but the Lab has no rendered-browser/DOM interaction primitive.
proposals.expected_benefit: Richer research and web testing without host authority.

proposals.title: Persistent toolchain/cache profiles
proposals.evidence: Slowest after-benchmark tasks remained package setup and Python venv creation.

proposals.title: Failure-specific recovery recipes
proposals.evidence: Five traced shell calls had exceptions/non-zero outcomes during Gen1, including restart races and a nested MCP deadlock experiment.
proposals.expected_benefit: Turn recurring errors into reusable diagnosis and regression fixtures.
